method: Built-in image_gen using the approved Border Collie as a graphic-style reference; converted into native SVG paths with vtracer 0.6.15 via scripts/trace-walking-artwork.py.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone BOSTON TERRIER in the established DNAture mint-and-ink animal engraving graphic line. The supplied Border Collie is ONLY a graphic-style reference for crisp tapered engraving strokes, palette and natural standing presentation; do not copy its breed, fur length or proportions. One realistic healthy adult Boston Terrier standing naturally on all FOUR legs facing RIGHT, body in side profile and head gently turned three-quarter toward the viewer. Unmistakable breed characteristics: small compact square athletic body with short level back, deep chest, clean moderate tuck, straight relatively slender sturdy legs and four distinct compact small paws. Square flat-topped head, short broad square muzzle, clearly defined stop, natural round attentive eyes of normal size, erect pointed triangular ears set at the corners of skull. Refined lighter-legged Boston proportions, not the bulky low-slung French Bulldog, no oversized rounded bat ears and no exaggerated face folds. Very short smooth sleek coat with characteristic tuxedo markings: open MINT central face blaze, muzzle band, chest bib and lower paws, denser INK engraving on the sides of head and torso. Express markings with engraved line density and fine mint fur detail inside darker areas, never literal black/white coat colors and never featureless dark masses. Natural short low-set tapering tail, relaxed, fully visible, not docked or cropped. Calm bright gentle expression, relaxed closed mouth, no human smile, no aggressive pose, anatomically plausible adult dog. Match reference's meticulous crisp tapered engraving and airy crosshatching but SHORT sleek coat strokes following body contours, restrained shadow density, open flat mint highlights and clear facial detail. EXACTLY TWO opaque interior inks: luminous mint #8FE4D9 and deep cool ink teal #092F39. Mint-dominant overall with readable fine engraving in coat markings. Square canvas with comfortable genuinely transparent margins around both pointed ears, nose, full natural tail and all four paws, entire animal uncropped. Genuine alpha transparency immediately outside crisp silhouette, under belly and between legs, opaque mint inside animal. No background, floor, printed checkerboard, ground shadow, halo, glow, haze, gradients, blur, photographic texture, cartoon, 3D, text, watermark, frame, collar, clothing, props, extra animals, literal white, black, brown, orange, cream, sepia or warm colors. A reusable clean transparent cutout engraving matching the DNAture breed series.

tracing.note: Lower threshold preserves mint engraving detail within the darker tuxedo markings.
